Ssarith badge, the Bow Rites

All Fleet Command mockups (the tracker)

SD from the Emblem Design Guide as a badge 100 mm across: three of the Hunt's bows in laminated wood, one for each stage of life, overlapping and aimed right, each a step prouder than the one behind it; steel arrows with hard green heads, each its own shape, and red feathers tipped orange; sunk 9 mm below the rim, a bed of modelled ferns, the deep fronds in shadow and the top ones in the light; a rim of bone-pale metal. Drag to turn it, scroll or pinch to zoom.

Surfaces: Material Maker maps (colour, normal, AO, roughness and metal, specular). Change faction-emblems.
